children: Eli Lilly and Company (NYSE:LLY) surged on strong Q2 results and raised guidance as Mounjaro, Zepbound and oral Foundayo drive growth while advances from Inluriyo, Retatrutide, Foundayo and CAR‑T/vaccine investments plus pricing moves and legal risks reshape its commercial and R&D outlook.
Previous Week Recap
Q2 Revenue Boost, Guides Up
: Eli Lilly (LLY) Q2 2026 revenue $22.97B (+48% Y/Y) driven by Mounjaro and Zepbound; non-GAAP EPS $8.38; raises 2026 revenue guide to $85–$87B.
FDA Approves Inluriyo/Verzenio Combo
: Eli Lilly (LLY) got FDA full approval for Inluriyo plus Verzenio for ER+, HER2–, ESR1‑mutant advanced breast cancer. EMBER‑3: combo PFS 11.1 vs 5.5 months (n=159). Label lists serious safety risks.
ACHIEVE-4 Finds MACE Risk Reduction
: Eli Lilly (LLY) reported Phase 3 ACHIEVE-4: Foundayo cut MACE‑3 risk 23% vs insulin glargine. Phase 1 eloraTZP showed 17% mean weight loss over 16 weeks.
Triumph-2: Retatrutide Weight Loss
: Eli Lilly (LLY) will present Phase 3 Triumph-2 data for weekly obesity drug Retatrutide in Milan: up to 20.8% mean weight loss at 80 weeks and A1C drops up to 1.6%; FDA filing planned early 2027
GENEROUS Program Lowers Medicaid Prices

: Eli Lilly (LLY) joined the White House MFN drug-pricing GENEROUS program, lowering U.S. Medicaid prices to align with other developed nations; move may cut government drug spending over coming years.
Foundayo Drives 30% U.S. Starts
: Eli Lilly (LLY) says oral obesity drug Foundayo accounts for over 30% of new U.S. patient starts in the oral GLP-1/obesity market, indicating early commercial traction.
Zepbound Litigation Denied Causation
: Eli Lilly (LLY) faces U.S. lawsuits claiming its GLP‑1 drug Zepbound caused NAION vision loss; company denies causation, cites studies and defends drug safety and efficacy.
Medicare Bridge Expands Obesity Access
: Eli Lilly (LLY) says Medicare Bridge could expand obesity-treatment access; engaging employers and state Medicaid programs; estimates a large eligible population for its obesity drugs.
TuneLab Expands Antibody Characterization
: Eli Lilly (LLY) added Twist Bioscience to its TuneLab platform for antibody characterization and wet‑lab data, feeding high‑throughput data into TuneLab’s AI/ML and AbLab predictability model.
Diversifying Beyond GLP-1 Pipeline
: Eli Lilly (LLY) is investing in CAR‑T, immunology and vaccines to diversify its pipeline and sustain revenue beyond the GLP‑1 obesity/diabetes peak amid patent risks.
